title: Trump Seeks a Boost for Hemp That Would Benefit a Top Aide’s Family
summary: At the White House’s request, senators tucked a change sought by the hemp industry into a crucial spending bill. It would benefit the son-in-law of Susie Wiles, the president’s chief of staff.
